title: Chapter 168: The Fall Of A General
content:
Chapter 168: The Fall Of A General

Wang Shuo's strength was still much weaker than that of the opponent, and his spear was always deflected.

After a few rounds, he fell into a slump. Fortunately, Ayub was by his side, so Wang Shuo was not afraid of fighting. He persisted for about ten minutes without any danger.

This time, Wang Shuo also wanted to see the gap between himself and the senior generals. He did not immediately let Ayub join the battlefield, nor did he let Li Jianguo on the opposite side shoot the spear.

Gong Zheng behind him had not arrived yet. If he launched an attack at this time, he might alarm the enemy and cause the opponent to escape.

Finally, after a while, there was a commotion at the tail of the bandits.

"Report to the boss, our retreat has been blocked." A bandit shouted anxiously at Zhang Wenlong who was fighting fiercely.

Zhang Wenlong was shocked when he heard this. He held the sword with both hands and exerted force suddenly, increasing his offensive and strength, forcing Wang Shuo back. At the same time, he also stepped back a few steps and pulled away.

"What did you say?" He grabbed the bandit's collar, and a trace of panic flashed through his mind.

If he was stuck in such a narrow place, even he would be in great danger.

Before he could react, five bronze spears were shot from the opposite side of the cliff, blocking an area near him.

He had no way to avoid it, and after knocking away one spear, he was still pierced by two spears.

"Puff!"

He was nailed directly to the wall.

The other bandit was even worse, his head was shot directly, and blood mixed with brain matter fell to the ground.

Seeing this, Ayub rushed over quickly, and the Qinglong knife was directly against Zhang Wenlong's neck.

He captured Zhang Wenlong directly.

Wang Shuo didn't expect that this matter would be so smooth.

He couldn't help but look at the bronze crossbow car in the distance, revealing a deep fear.

Fortunately, this big killer is his own!

In future battles, the enemy will definitely have various heavy weapons, so it seems that we have to be careful.

Seeing the capture of the leader, the bandits immediately fell into chaos.

"Surrender and you won't be killed!"

"Surrender and you won't be killed!"

...

Wang Shuo shouted, and the cavalry behind him also shouted.

"Hua, hua!"

The sound of weapons falling to the ground sounded.

At this point, Wang Shuo finally defeated the bandits completely.

At the foot of the mountain, Wang Shuo looked at the nearly 200 bandits escorted and fell into deep thought.

How to deal with this group of people made Wang Shuo a little troubled.

Wang Shuo certainly couldn't kill them all.

If they were allowed to join Wana Village, their loyalty would be a problem.

He didn't have so many "Thought Stamp" scrolls.

He could only take it one step at a time!

Wang Shuo did not go up the mountain to occupy the mountain stronghold himself. Now the most urgent task is to immediately return to Wana Village.

"Who is the blind man who dares to attack Wana Village! He is simply ignorant of life and death!" Wang Shuo muttered angrily.

"Duan Wenxi, how are you now?"

"Boss, come back quickly, the enemy's archers are too powerful, we dare not show our heads at all. If our walls were not high and the enemy did not prepare siege weapons, I'm afraid your Wana Village would be gone!"

"How ridiculous! You hold on, we are on the way back."

In a valley 5 miles away from the village, Wang Shuo stopped the main force and sent Ayub to scout the enemy.

Although Duan Wenxi had reported the enemy situation, Wang Shuo was still a little worried. If the enemy had an ambush, it would be bad.
